subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — GreenGrid co-sell approval lane
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@greengrid.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Apr 2026 09:17:00 -0700
Subject: AWS Marketplace private offer — initial ask and buyer approval path

Hi Julia,

Thanks again for the demo last week — really excited about the potential to instrument GreenGrid's forecasting pipeline with Redwood inference. Per our call you asked for a marketplace-first purchase path so internal procurement can buy through AWS with a Private Offer (PO) and still get co-sell support from AWS.

To make the private offer workable for your buyers we need two things from you:
1) A target contract term (12/24/36 months) and preferred commit model (annual draw vs monthly usage).
2) The procurement approval ladder (who signs, who needs approvals >$250k).

Attached: GreenGrid_Ratecard_Request.xlsx to capture target terms. Also including a short SOC2 summary for your security team.

If you can send that by Wednesday I’ll loop in our Marketplace ops and AWS partner lead to draft the private offer and a co-sell registration plan.

Next steps we propose:
- You: reply with procurement ladder + preferred term
- Us: draft PO and proposed discount tiers, route to internal approvals
- Joint: schedule 30-min walk-through with AWS Partner Success (if needed)

Thanks,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182

[Attachment: GreenGrid_Ratecard_Request.xlsx (xlsx)]
[Attachment: GG_SOC2_Summary.pdf (pdf)]

From: Julia Park <julia.park@greengrid.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: GreenGrid Procurement <procurement@greengrid.com>, AWS Partner Success <aws-partner-success@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Apr 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: AWS Marketplace private offer — initial ask and buyer approval path

Hi Mina — attaching our completed ratecard and the procurement ladder. Summary here:
- Preferred term: 24 months with option to renew at year 2 pricing review.
- Buyer approval matrix: up to $100k CM can be approved by Business Lead (Julia Park). $100k-$500k requires VP Procurement signoff. Anything > $500k needs CFO approval and a commercial review board.
- GreenGrid prefers annual invoicing against committed spend when possible.

Question: will Redwood allow a 45-day invoice SLA on the private offer? Procurement is strict about cashflow windows.

Happy to schedule a call with AWS PS if it helps speed approvals.

Thanks,
Julia

[Attachment: GreenGrid_Ratecard_Request_completed.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karima Singh <karima_singh@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Apr 2026 08:55:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: GreenGrid procurement ladder — need quick internal approval lane

Folks — forwarding GreenGrid's procurement ladder and term ask (24m, annual invoice preferred). Key asks we need to resolve:
- Pricing: they want co-sell discount that keeps AWS motivated. AWS typically expects 20-30% off list for co-sell registration for ISVs on private offers.
- Payment terms: GreenGrid requested 45-day invoice SLA — Product/Finance sign-off required.
- Approvals: any >$500k requires CFO; likely their first year commit will be ~$420k so VP Procurement signoff should be enough.

Can Legal/Finance confirm we can:
1) Provide a 25% marketplace discount tiered by commit bands;
2) Accept 45-day invoicing for this customer (we may need to escalate exceptions);
3) Issue the private offer template for AWS ops to populate.

Ben/Karima — pinging you for fast turn. Julia is asking for a draft private offer this week.

-Karthik

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Karima Singh <karima_singh@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Apr 2026 14:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: GreenGrid procurement ladder — need quick internal approval lane

Karthik / team — quick answers after review:
- Pricing: Finance ok to support a 25% off list private-offer discount for first-year commit bands up to $500k. We should add a narrow accelerated volume tier (>= $750k) that revisits discounting.
- Invoice SLA: 45 days is outside our standard 30-day; Finance will approve a one-off 45-day term for GreenGrid if Sales confirms the deal economics and Legal signs the clause.
- Template: attached RDW_AWS_Private_Offer_Template_v3.docx — Legal please populate and include our standard KYC/security stub.

Karima: can Legal run the 45-day clause and add indemnity language acceptable to AWS? If yes, Mina can send the draft to Julia and AWS to start the private offer creation.

-Ben

[Attachment: RDW_AWS_Private_Offer_Template_v3.docx (docx)]

From: Karima Singh <karima_singh@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Apr 2026 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: Re: GreenGrid procurement ladder — Legal signoff on invoice SLA and PO wording

Ben / team — Legal has reviewed. We can accept a 45-day invoice SLA with one caveat: require an initial 12-month auto-renew opt-out notice (30 days) and maintain our standard limitation-of-liability language. I've added a short KYC paragraph and the SOC2 reference to the template.

I updated the template and flagged the change log. If Sales confirms, we can route to AWS Marketplace ops for private offer creation.

-Karima

[Attachment: RDW_AWS_Private_Offer_Template_v3_legal_markups.docx (docx)]

From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Julia Park <julia.park@greengrid.com>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.com>, AWS Partner Success <aws-partner-success@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 15:03:00 -0700
Subject: Private offer draft & next steps (DocuSign + AWS registration)

Hi Julia — thanks for the quick turnaround and patience while we routed approvals. Summary of the draft private offer we are ready to submit to AWS: 
- Term: 24 months, annual invoicing against committed spend
- Year 1 committed spend: $420,000 (proposed)
- Marketplace discount: 25% off list for Year 1; volume triggers for year 2 renewal conversation
- Invoice SLA: 45 days (one-off exception approved by Redwood Finance + Legal with auto-renew opt-out clause)
- Signatories: VP Procurement (GreenGrid) and Redwood CFO for values >$250k internal signoff chain handled by us

Attached is the populated private offer template and a DocuSign link for GreenGrid to sign. Once we have signatures we’ll coordinate with AWS Partner Success to register the co-sell and create the AWS Private Offer record.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/link/abc123-greengrid
AWS PO preview: aws://marketplace/private-offers/rdw-gg-0426

Would you be able to get VP Procurement signoff by Friday 24th? We’ll keep AWS Partner Success on standby to fast-track registration once signatures are in place.

Thanks,
Mina

--
Mina Haddad
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.com | (415) 555-0182
